title: SE implementation scratchpad - Aurora Bank (daybook)
content:
Daily scratchpad - Aurora Bank private deployment (working notes)

Context:
- Customer wants private VPC deployment behind bank firewall for audit/compliance. KMS + HSM requirement. Must support model pinning and canary rollout for prompt-sensitive flows.
- Main model: open-llama-13B-quant (customer prefers non-embeddings inference first). Latency target < 300ms p50 for short prompts (<=128 tokens).

Today (2024-11-08) goals:
- Finalize VPC peering steps with infra + networking (Ethan to confirm routes).
- Confirm KMS key rotation cadence and HSM integration (Miguel to check legal/Security notes).
- Prototype canary rollout config: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%; auto-fallback to hosted-compatible variant if dedicated capacity low.
- Write smoke test plan for canary (prompt set + tolerance thresholds).

Action items / TODO:
- [ ] Get Aurora Bank AWS account IDs and CIDR blocks (pending). (assigned: Aurora SRE)
- [ ] Create VPC peering request doc + commands and share with customer networking. (me)
- [ ] Add KMS IAM policy sample to confluence page. (Miguel)
- [ ] Validate model quantization profile on customer NVMe-backed hosts - schedule quick bench run (Zoe).
- [ ] Draft rollback playbook for canary failure (timebox, metrics, runbook). (me)

Config notes / snippets:
- Model: open-llama-13B-quant (v1.3.0)
- Serving runtime: rrt-2024-10-5
- Canary config (draft):
  - route: /predict/aurora-sensitive
  - primary: open-llama-13B-quant:v1.3.0
  - canary: open-llama-13B-quant:v1.4.0-quant-test
  - traffic_split: ["canary": 0.10, "primary": 0.90]
  - metrics: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, error_rate, semantic-accuracy (eval set)

Networking checklist:
- Request peering with account: 987654321 (Aurora-prod)
- Add route table entry: 10.12.0.0/16 -> peering-conn-aurora
- Ensure SG opens outbound TLS 443 to Redwood control plane IP ranges (see confluence list)
- Confirm NAT/Gateway requirements for autoscaling nodes to reach update servers

KMS / Secrets:
- Customer requires BYOK; they will provide ARN of CMK (alias/aws/aurora-llm). Need sample KMS policy and envelope encryption example.
- TODO: Add HSM handshake step to onboarding checklist.

Smoke test plan (canary):
- 50 prompts from Aurora prompt set (mix of short instructs and multi-turn).
- Pass criteria: semantic-accuracy >= 92% vs baseline, p50 <= 350ms, error_rate < 1%
- If failure: immediately shift traffic to primary (0% canary) and create incident ticket; notify customer.

Blockers / questions:
- Does Aurora SRE accept peering or prefer Transit Gateway? (ask in network sync 11/09)
- Need explicit RPO for audit logs retention (how long to keep inference logs?).
- Confirm whether we should enable KV-cache persistence across restarts for cost reasons (affects cold-start latency).

Meeting notes (2024-11-07 sync):
- Aurora asked for clear rollback SLA and a way to ask for emergency pause of all canaries (security/legal).
- They prefer staged rollout by customer region; will provide region list next week.
- Action: provide a one-pager on canary safety nets and data flows (deliver by 11/10).

Quick commands / check-list for local bench (keep here):
- run bench: ./tools/bench --model open-llama-13B-quant --seq 128 --gpu g5 --duration 120
- start canary: rwctl rollout start --route "/predict/aurora-sensitive" --canary-image open-llama-13B-quant:v1.4.0-quant-test --traffic 0.1
- rollback canary: rwctl rollout update --route "/predict/aurora-sensitive" --traffic 0.0

Notes to self:
- Keep prompts anonymized prior to sharing externally.
- Capture any flakiness in pod scheduling during bench and raise with release-eng.

Next steps (short):
1) Draft VPC peering doc + send to Ethan by EOD 11/08.
2) Add canary smoke test harness to CI (small job) - target 11/12.
3) Sync with Legal on KMS/HSM questions - put on weekly legal sync.

End of scratchpad entry.
